ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is parallelogram MNPR, with M at the upper left, N at the upper right, P at the lower right, and R at the lower left. The two diagonals MP and RN intersect at the interior point Q. On the right side of point Q, the angle formed by rays QN and QP is labeled 83°. What is asked for is ∠MQR, that is, the angle on the left side of point Q formed by rays QM and QR. Reasoning: Diagonals MP and RN intersect, forming two pairs of vertical angles at the intersection point Q. ∠MQR and the 83° angle marked in the figure are vertical angles, so they are equal. Therefore m∠MQR = 83°.

raw_record.question_text: Use parallelogram MNPR to find $m \angle MQR$.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, identify MNPR as a parallelogram with diagonals MP and RN crossing at Q. The target angle ∠MQR is the angle at Q formed by rays QM and QR, on the left side of the diagonal intersection. The diagram labels the opposite angle at Q, formed by QN and QP, as 83°. Since these two angles are vertical angles created by the intersecting diagonals MP and RN, they are congruent. Therefore m∠MQR = 83°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是平行四边形 MNPR，M 在左上，N 在右上，P 在右下，R 在左下。两条对角线 MP 和 RN 在内部点 Q 相交。Q 点右侧、由射线 QN 和 QP 形成的角标为 83°。要求的是 ∠MQR，即由射线 QM 和 QR 形成的 Q 点左侧角。
推理：对角线 MP 与 RN 相交，在交点 Q 处形成两组对顶角。∠MQR 与图中标出的 83°角是对顶角，因此它们相等。所以 m∠MQR = 83°。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read that diagonals MP and RN intersect at Q, that ∠MQR is opposite the angle labeled 83° at Q, and that the labeled 83° angle is formed by the same two intersecting lines.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply the vertical angles theorem: opposite angles formed by two intersecting lines are equal.
